{"message": "Fixed the off-by-one / bounds checking defect in `decode_string_buf` and `json_unescape_string` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/utils/json.c`.

### Cause
`decode_string_buf` previously truncated the input length passed to `json_unescape_string` to `size - 1` when `escaped_len >= size` and then checked `if (escaped_len > size)` instead of detecting whether the unescaped string exceeded the destination buffer capacity (`size - 1` characters plus the null terminator). When `escaped_len == size` (such as a 10-character string decoded into a 10-byte buffer in `test_json_string_array_max`), it silently truncated the string and returned `0` instead of `-EINVAL`.

### Fix
Updated `json_unescape_string` and `decode_string_buf` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/utils/json.c` to pass the full `escaped_len` to `json_unescape_string` and return `-EINVAL` if the destination buffer is exhausted before all source characters are unescaped (`src < src_end`), if `dst_size == 0`, or if a two-byte passthrough sequence cannot fit before `dst_end`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
